_previous.title: Carolina Retractable Wall Hook (Patent Pending)
_previous.description: Avondale Decor's retractable wall hook is a unique and space-saving solution for hanging coats, robes, towels, or any other items you need to keep within reach. The hook installs quickly and easily without the need for additional support on or built into the wall — just drill a hole and use the included toggle bolts to fasten it in place. The rod pulls out to provide 2-1/2" of hanging space, then can be pushed back in so it's out of the way when not in use. Choose from 17 stylish finishes and four different models to match your décor. Gives you the option to remove the knob tip supplied with the item and replace it with a cabinet knob of your own, allowing you to match existing ones in the room! Can hold up to 15 pounds Fits standard interior walls Installation does require drilling a 3/4" dia. hole through drywall and 3 small holes around 2 1/2" of hanging space All mounting hardware included Specification & Documentation Product dimensions, in.
